questions.question: What is MUV White Phenyl™?
questions.answer: A pine-oil-emulsion-based, milky white floor cleaner.

questions.question: What sizes does it come in?
questions.answer: 1L and 5L, both confirmed by both sources, no conflict.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: LIVE — resolve from Product Catalog API.

questions.question: Do I need to dilute it?
How long should I leave it on the floor?

questions.answer: No — independently confirmed to be a genuinely separate, distinctly formulated product.
